description: Coerce a victim and relay its NTLM to SMB on a target where it is local admin, for code execution.

telemetry.detail: Authentication coercion (PetitPotam MS-EFSR, PrinterBug MS-RPRN, DFSCoerce, etc.) generates distinctive RPC traffic to the victim.
Relayed NTLM authentication lands as a logon on the relay target.
Coercion-plus-relay chains are heavily signatured; NTLM relay is a well-known, widely detected pattern.
Service installed on the relay target if a service-based exec is used. SCM event, logged in System, not Security.

prerequisite_privilege: Network position; SMB signing not required on the target; victim is admin there
notes: Needs SMB signing not enforced on the target and the coerced principal to be admin there.
